value.rationale: The complete-bipartite graphical zonotopes form a standard geometric family, explicitly discussed in shuffle and deformation theory. The generator-covariance ellipsoid is always a containment candidate but generally not sharp: showing exact minimal volume for every pair of part sizes is a motivated, nontrivial structural result. The full contact-vertex classification, positive optimization certificate, intrinsic volume and semiaxes make the result useful as an exact benchmark and as a connection between cut spaces, zonotope metric geometry, and Löwner optimality. It is not just a numerical recomputation or a textbook translation.
